responsibility: Holds the common i386 target configuration shared by Cygwin and MinGW PE/COFF environments. This header establishes the Windows-specific ABI and object-format policy for the backend, including DWARF/SEH unwind behavior, label-prefix conventions, Windows calling-convention predefines, DLL import/export handling, PE assembler hooks, function declaration and file-end emission hooks, profiling/runtime alignment rules, and related target macros that govern code generation and assembly output for the cygwin/mingw family.
same_name_distinction: Unlike cygming.opt, this is the shared Cygwin/MinGW target configuration header that defines PE/COFF ABI, assembler, unwind, and target-macro behavior; the .opt file only declares the corresponding command-line options.
